fixtures.preview: United head to Madrid for matchday 2 of the Champions League league phase, fresh from a 1-1 draw with Spurs.
talking_points: United drew 1-1 with Tottenham on Saturday: Bryan Mbeumo scored, but Dominic Solanke equalised in added time against ten men.
Carlos Baleba made his debut off the bench against Spurs, so he could feature in a midfield that has struggled for control.
Before the Spurs game Patrick Dorgu and Benjamin Sesko were reported out, with de Ligt and Ugarte also sidelined; no update for Madrid was found yet.
Atlético are tough at home in Europe, and United have left several leads slip this season.

The first season-opening Sydney Derby in A-League history, with both clubs under new head coaches and a full house expected.
talking_points: Wanderers coach Ufuk Talay makes his league debut in charge against his former club.
Sydney FC captain Rhyan Grant has played more Sydney Derbies than anyone and calls the atmosphere the best in Australian sport.
Sydney FC coach Patrick Kisnorbo says both sides will want to make a statement straight away.
Tickets start from $36, with juniors from $22.50 and family packs from $90.
